text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The countless shining stars that glitter 
brilliantly in racing history—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia, too, etched her name into the 
galaxy—with an explosive brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this time, I will make that voice... 
echo all the way to the ends of the 
universe.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I feel destiny with you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You, and you too!!
Won't you please follow 
me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely made it through the crucial 
three years for an Umamusume, Epiphaneia 
has lately been... relentlessly trying to 
woo me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Gran!! You're incredible! Your speed and 
power are top-notch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Right on! Thank you very much, 50 
miles worth!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With that incredible strength of yours, 
won't you lend some power to my voice?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A push from behind? What do you mean by 
that?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I realized it! Instead of doing it alone, 
I should borrow the strength of those I 
share a destined bond with!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—They say the best way is to teach like 
Cesario and Kris S do!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If we combine your power with my voice, 
we'll surely make something even more 
incredible happen...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Ah, Vivlos! You too!!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hae~?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've got amazing explosive power!
I just 
know that power will harmonize with my 
voice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Your strengths will give everyone power! 
So—feel my destiny!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, sorry, okay? Big Sis told me not 
to go feeling destiny too easily~."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Count me in!
I don't really get it either, 
so pass for me, please!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's just not working out!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I mean,
we felt that spark of destiny! We 
can't just take a number and wait our 
turn!"
choice_data_list: Could it be because you call out t...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Because it's destiny!
choice_data_list: Well, that may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, there's one thing 
that caught my attention. Up until now, 
she's worked so hard to awaken the voices 
of those she felt a destined connection 
with, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than anything else,
I feel like she 
was asking the girls she called out to 
earlier for help with 'making her voice 
even better.'
choice_data_list: Is there some kind of difference?
Is there some kind of difference?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Actually, I only found out 
about it recently...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I feel destiny at work, a light 
flashes like a star in my chest, but—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I realized there are two kinds! A warm 
kind, and a fiery kind!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The girls with that warm vibe each have 
their own wonderful charms!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If we borrow that power, our voices can 
become even stronger! I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Epi-san, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Gentil!! Have you finally made up your 
mind?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You feel our shared destiny, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My power and your power...
If the two come 
together, I know we can make a tremendous 
roar echo across the world!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...You seemed to have some free time. In 
that case, this is perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to run alongside me? I was 
looking for a partner with some real 
backbone.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“—If you wish to win me over,
I shall hear 
you out after that.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's go! Let's fight right now! 
—The 'Voice of Destiny' says so too!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's invite the girls who felt 
that burning destiny, too! I'm sure 
they'll learn a lot from this!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're fine with this too, right!
choice_data_list: Still, are you sure? Today is—
Still, are you sure? Today is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Those kids already have—voices 
of their own!
choice_data_list: Still, are you sure? Today is—
Still, are you sure? Today is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tact! You've got a visitor.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—Tact-san. Congratulations on your Make 
Debut.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eff-senpai! You came!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...Because we're both— people who've been 
influenced by Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. Then, please do watch over 
me until the end.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make the pride of my
hometown 
burst with all its might! —Just like 
Epi-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Epi & Gentil
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah...!" "Epi-san is incredible!" "I 
see, so that's how you run..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I knew it, this is fine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What we must do right now—is awaken this 
voice in as many girls as possible!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: As far as my light can reach!
choice_data_list: ("As far as I can reach," huh...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: (To the best of my ability, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right, voice! —Trainer, let's do 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that person is so fast! Though 
they're totally not catching up to the 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Let's all cheer them on! Ready, set—do 
your best—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—What a great view! Today I can see so,
so 
far away!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"This voice really is magnificent!! In 
other words, I am the greatest!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, without a doubt! My light 
will reach far into the distance!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—To the farthest reaches of the racing 
cosmos!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact, Eff, and everyone else... they all 
embraced my burning destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the voices awakened in everyone
will 
one day— turn into their very own voices.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Still! My voice won't just disappear! It 
will resonate in everyone's hearts, and 
our destiny will spread—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Hey,
Trainer! —You remember our Christmas 
promise, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will see your destiny through to the 
very end!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will watch over your destiny until
the 
very end!’"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And that end means the end of this very 
universe! Until then, my voice will keep 
echoing on and on!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The view we'll see standing side by side 
then...
will without a doubt be beautiful! 
I'm sure of it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Are you prepared to see this through?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I am an Umamusume favored by fate! And—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"With you, who loves my destiny, I shall 
walk together to the ends of the earth!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A supernova explosion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the demise of a giant star.
Yet its 
explosion illuminated the entire universe 
with blinding radiance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how far the light shining from 
Epiphaneia will reach...
is something only 
the future knows.
